# Velair 1.9.3-beta.5

This beta makes High braking depth configurable per zone and clarifies equipment requests in Home Assistant's activity log.

## ✨ Added

- Configure **High braking steps** under **Settings > Climates and groups**, from **2 to 10 equipment steps**, with **2 by default**. Settings shows the equivalent Celsius or Fahrenheit difference, and Room Assist keeps its existing selector while displaying the configured depth. Heating and cooling retain the same withdrawal and resumption thresholds. ([#61](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/61))

## 🚀 Improved

- Home Assistant's activity log distinguishes the room target from the equipment request when they differ, including temporary preparation extras, their removal and device rounding. ([#63](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/63))

## 🧭 Notes

- This prerelease follows [1.9.3-beta.4](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.3-beta.4).
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
